diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Sitronix ST7735S V1.1 datasheet, DC characteristics: 'System Voltage VDD Operating Voltage 2.5 (min) 2.75 (typ) 4.8 (max) V' and 'Interface Operation Voltage VDDI 1.65 (min) 1.8 (typ) 3.7 (max) V'. The Waveshare schematic ties header pin 1 (net '3.3V') straight to the LCD's VCC and IOVCC with only a 1 uF decoupling cap, no regulator, so the module's floor is the chip's (VDD >= 2.5 V). The 3.0 V vmin is inside that range (conservative margin, 3.0-3.6 V band around 3.3 V). The second reading's 3.3 V is the vendor's nominal operating voltage ('Operating voltage: 3.3V/5V' on the Waveshare wiki), not a minimum; it also used the older ST7735 (non-S) V1.9 datasheet (VDD 2.6-3.3 V), a different chip revision, and even that gives a 2.6 V minimum, below 3.0 V.
